answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 8991 Country: Pakistan Title: Dear Sir, My uncle is living in Bulgaria. There are neither Muslims and nor Mosque in their locality. What are Islamic Injunctions about his Juma Prayer. Question: Dear Sir, My uncle is living in Bulgaria. There are neither Muslims and nor Mosque in their locality. What are Islamic Injunctions about his Juma Prayer. Answer ID: 8991 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1517/1271=L/1429) If there is any mosque in adjacent localities he should go there. If there is no mosque at all, then four-five Muslims can perform Juma Salah collectively at a place, it is not necessary to offer it in mosque. If it is difficult to get some Muslims, then he can pray Zuhr (instead of Juma) alone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
